documents.subject: Invoice AP-00440 review and supporting detail
documents.body:
To: Granite Legal 020 <ap20@supplier.example>

Hello Granite Legal 020,

We are reviewing invoice AP-00440 for Meridian Ledger Labs, Inc. The invoice is posted and references purchase order PO-00440. The recorded amount is $2,749.57, with a due date of 2025-09-27. Please provide any available explanation or supporting detail for the billed services so our records can remain aligned with the related purchasing and receipt information. This message is a same-day review request and does not confirm payment or any additional approval.

Regards,
Casey Team05

documents.subject: AP-00440 reconciliation thread
documents.body: Casey Team05: I’m checking the posted invoice AP-00440 against PO-00440 and receipt RC-AP-00440. The recorded invoice and purchase order amounts both convert to $2,749.57, and the receipt records the same accepted amount. Granite Legal 020 is listed as the supplier billing contact. I do not see an explanation for the underlying service detail in the packet, so that should be requested before we treat the review as complete. No payment or additional approval is established here.

documents.subject: Question regarding AP-00440 and PO-00440
documents.body: Can Casey Team05 confirm what supporting explanation is available for invoice AP-00440 from Granite Legal 020?
